acceptance_tests: The approved revision 0.3 proposal fingerprint and every successor-bundle artifact pass ready validation before any Pamplist DSP source is changed.

The configured patcher checkout matches catalog/sources.lock.json at commit 08d3e6e1e2b61230308c20a15ded58ffdaf4656c; the synthesis subtree has Git tree 58917f3e2e46a30337cfb6292a3504845b1d5552 and no tracked or untracked drift.
Changing any base voice field for one lane leaves all seven non-target accepted VoiceControls records byte-identical.
Two or more active lanes can simultaneously resolve to different source-order engines, and one lane's Model Mod changes only that lane's resolved engine.
A stochastic MacroVoice produces byte-identical output and random state whether processed alone or with arbitrary processing of another stochastic MacroVoice interleaved between its quanta.
Changing or resetting one lane's engine cannot reconstruct, trigger, advance, or alter another lane's source state, scheduler state, or accepted controls.
Every source engine index 0 through 23 maps to the frozen nonempty descriptive name and renders finite bounded main and auxiliary output.
All eight voices render simultaneously through a 64-bit additive main and auxiliary mixer; nominal frozen conditions have zero final saturation and extreme input remains Q27 bounded.
The frozen experiment produces byte-identical PCM, canonical per-lane event traces, final accepted snapshots, and metrics at host partitions 1, 16, 64, 128, 257, and 512 frames.
Stopped transport and declared zero subcases produce exact silence, while all nominal output is finite and bounded.

Synthetic regular Launch Control 3 tests exhaust lane selection, local route and temporal transforms, invalid input, and accepted-state reflection against control-map.json without changing non-target lanes.
Repeated Core processing performs no allocation, lock, file I/O, JSON work, endpoint work, or UI work after construction.
The authenticated local JUCE 8.0.15 tree configures, compiles, and links Pamplist.app without launching it or opening audio or MIDI endpoints.
Focused, adjacent, routine current, affected native, and relocated configured-source reproduction pass after implementation freeze.
RESULTS.md and GAPS.md keep target-build evidence separate from real-time, connected-device, listening, embedded, distribution, and production claims.

dependency_contracts: The macro voices are consumed from the configured patcher source at locked commit 08d3e6e1e2b61230308c20a15ded58ffdaf4656c and synthesis tree 58917f3e2e46a30337cfb6292a3504845b1d5552; configuration fails closed on missing, dirty, or mismatched bytes.

The local MacroVoice adapter may call the exact source's plaits_stmlib::Random::Seed and state functions to save and restore one deterministic context per Pamplist voice, but it must not copy or modify source bytes or promote the catalogued-only dependency.
The source adapter is owned by one single-threaded Pamplist Core render path; concurrent source calls from multiple Core instances are not claimed because the dependency RNG is process-global.
Instrument Lab v1 supplies the portable host seam and noncanonical validation boundary; Pamplist owns musical controls, eight-voice topology, engine labels, and mixer.
JUCE 8.0.15 is an authenticated local build dependency with network fetching disabled and does not enter the portable Core.
The regular Launch Control 3 topology artifact is protocol authority for Custom Mode 1 channel 16 CC20 through CC47; all endpoint behavior remains deferred.
